stemMd: How many attempted jobs were unsuccessful?
explanationMd: Subtract qualifying cases from the total: 600-510=90. The total already includes both outcomes, so subtraction counts each unsuccessful case exactly once.

distractorRationale.a: This includes only the middle category rather than all three.
distractorRationale.c: This counts qualifying cases rather than the complementary cases.
distractorRationale.d: This counts every case, including successful ones.
